Comptroller in Brooklyn CB18, by Election District

The statewide Comptroller primary as it ran across Brooklyn Community Board 18 — Canarsie, Flatlands, Mill Basin, Bergen Beach, and Marine Park — broken out by the five Assembly Districts that cover the board, then down to the election district.

Each bar is one AD's ballots in CB18, split by candidate. DiNapoli carries the board by his largest margin anywhere in Brooklyn, winning every election district and all five AD portions; the large AD 59 portion anchors the result.
